title: Braided Pulse
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -6 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: This is a continuous excerpt from the MIDDLE of an already-playing full-volume song, not an intro. The first and last beats both have clear drums, bass, chords and melody at a stable level. Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo MELODIC HOUSE instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 126 BPM in 4/4. A steady four-on-the-floor kick lands on every quarter beat, crisp clap on beats two and four, light eighth-note hats, a short pitched pluck on each quarter beat, rounded bass and warm chord stabs stay individually audible for the full duration. Signature hook: a low two-note glass-marimba call rises into a four-note bright synth reply; the two voices cross in alternating bars like braided sound waves, with a distinct rest before each reply. At 64 seconds maintain the same groove and energy, change the bass roots, reverse the four-note contour and let the lower voice answer a beat earlier. Keep every 8-second span musically active with clear attacks and a natural evolving arrangement, not an exact duplicated half. No quiet intro, long build, half-time break, filter fade, silent tail, tempo drift, harsh distortion, vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of another song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original editorial comic-print cover: two interwoven sound ribbons, one electric cyan and one warm ivory, crossing around a single coral pulse node. Dark ink paper, sparse halftone, compact central motif readable at narrow card width, no characters or copied game symbols.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Original horizontal editorial card with the same interwoven two-ribbon motif on the right and crisp duohertz and Braided Pulse lettering on the left. Purpose-composed wide layout, not a stretched square.
